data.one_liner: A high-performance, asynchronous serial port plugin for Flutter using Dart FFI and Native Assets.
data.what_it_does: It enables communication with serial and RS232 devices across Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and Web. It uses a native C++ worker thread for async I/O and provides a reactive stream for incoming data and device events.
use_when: You need to communicate with RS232, USB-serial adapters, or hardware COM ports from Flutter.
You require cross-platform serial port support including desktop, Android, and web browsers.
avoid_when: You are targeting Firefox or Safari on the web, as they do not support the Web Serial API.
You only need high-level network communication (such as HTTP or WebSockets).
strengths: Asynchronous I/O via native C++ worker thread keeps the UI thread free.
Reactive stream interface for incoming data and events.
Supports Native Assets on desktop and Android USB Host API without manual library copying.
weaknesses: Modem control lines and some configurations are not supported on the web platform.
Android requires specific USB host permissions configured in the manifest.
data.setup_notes: For Android, add the uses-feature tag for usb.host in AndroidManifest.xml. On the web, works in Chrome and Edge 89+.
